subject: Oncall plan amendment & SLO review
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@pagerlite.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Oncall plan amendment & SLO review

Hi Jordan —

Quick one from our side: our oncall footprint has expanded faster than expected and we need to amend our PagerLite subscription to reflect 24/7 coverage, add a Status Page product, and tighten the incident SLO guarantees for high-priority pages. Key asks: 

- Add 40 additional oncall seats (total will move from 60 -> 100 active seats for paging).
- Add StatusPage product (public & internal views) with up to 6 components.
- SLO target: P1 median time-to-ack under 3 mins during business hours, and under 6 mins 24/7. We need the SLOs and escalation matrix documented.
- Pricing ask: please provide a revised 12-month committed quote and indicate any volume or term discounts.
- Procurement path: we’ll be paying via PO; Monica will own ordering once terms are agreed.

Can you send a redlineable amendment and a simple pricing breakdown (per-seat and per-statuspage) by EOD Friday? Also confirm whether PagerLite will include audit logs and whether incident payloads are retained for 90 days by default.

Thanks — simple responses appreciated so I can brief SOC and Procurement.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Partner, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@pagerlite.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: PagerLite Sales <sales@pagerlite.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Oncall plan amendment & SLO review

Hi Rishi,

Thanks — this is straightforward, happy to help. Attached is a draft amendment (PagerLite_Amendment_v2.pdf) and a one-sheet pricing breakdown (PL_pricing_breakdown.xlsx). High level:

- Seats: incremental per-seat pricing shown in the spreadsheet; we can cap overages for agreed monthly volumes.
- StatusPage: flat monthly fee per public page + small per-component charge; internal views are included.
- SLOs: we can commit to a P1 median acknowledge of 2.5 mins business hours, 5.5 mins 24/7 for a 12-month commitment at the discounted rate. SLA credits available for missed SLOs (see amendment).
- Audit logs & retention: incident payloads and audit trails are retained for 180 days by default. We can configure 90 days if you prefer; there is a small storage delta fee (detailed in the spreadsheet).

We’re able to offer a 10% term discount on the base subscription if Redwood commits to a 12-month renew/extend on signature and issues the PO within 30 days.

Would you like a short call Monday to walk through the amendment and redlines?

Best,
Jordan Price
Enterprise Sales, PagerLite
Attachments: PagerLite_Amendment_v2.pdf (PDF, 432KB stub), PL_pricing_breakdown.xlsx (Excel, 58KB stub)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@pagerlite.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Oncall plan amendment & SLO review

Jordan —

Thanks for the docs. A couple of legal/proc questions before we move to PO: 

1) Data retention / export: can PagerLite provide an export of incident payloads and audit logs on request? We need a documented approach for eDiscovery and regulatory audit support.
2) DPA & subprocessing: please confirm the current DPA addendum and whether any subprocessors change with the StatusPage product.
3) SLA credits: please summarize how credits are calculated and the crediting process (invoice offset or credit note).

Monica will be the procurement owner for the PO; Monica, can you confirm the internal account code and whether we can sign the amendment or require a standalone SOW?

If you can answer 1–3 in line, we can pickup redline after that.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@pagerlite.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@pagerlite.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Oncall plan amendment & SLO review

Lauren —

Quick answers inline: 

1) Export: yes — we provide full incident & audit log export via S3 export or on-demand CSV with authenticated transfer. We’ll include the export playbook as an appendix in the amendment.
2) DPA & subprocessors: current DPA remains unchanged; StatusPage uses the same set of subprocessors (list provided in our SOC2 package). I’m attaching the SOC2 link here: https://pagerlite.com/security/soc2-report. If you want the DPA redline, our legal team can prepare.
3) SLA credits: credits are calculated as percentage of monthly fees for a measured SLO miss and are applied as a credit on the next invoice. We summarize examples in the amendment (section 4).

Concessions: we can confirm the 10% term discount for a 12-month commitment and waive the first-month per-component surcharge for StatusPage.

If helpful, I can set a 30-min call Tuesday 11am PT to walk the amendment and pricing.

—Jordan
Jordan Price
Enterprise Sales, PagerLite
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@pagerlite.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 16:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Oncall plan amendment & SLO review

Thanks Jordan — that addresses the immediate questions. Next steps from Redwood: 

- We’ll take the 12-month commitment with the 10% discount and the waived first-month StatusPage surcharge, contingent on a minor legal redline to the DPA (Lauren will coordinate).
- Monica, please confirm procurement code and PO owner; we intend to issue PO within 30 days per the vendor concession. Monica, can you also confirm whether Redwood prefers an amendment to the existing agreement or a standalone SOW?
- Markus, can you validate the SLO targets (2.5 / 5.5 median) against our oncall run rate and confirm any additional tooling integrations needed?
- Tessa, please prepare a short migration checklist for runbook entries and notify the SRE rotation of upcoming component additions. I’ve attached a short internal cost summary.

Jordan — let’s take the Tuesday 11am PT call; I’ll send calendar invites once Monica confirms PO path.

Thanks all — Rishi

Attachments: internal_cost_summary.xlsx (Excel, 26KB stub)
